name: northlake-portal.account.get
description: Read the patient on file, insurance, portal contact details, confirmation settings, any pending interstitial page and a balance summary. Always allowed, even while an interstitial is pending.

name: northlake-portal.messages.list
description: List message threads grouped by recipient with unread counts and the latest message preview. Closed threads are included unless status is "open".

name: northlake-portal.messages.get
description: Read one thread with every message, author, read flag and attachment IDs. Reading does not mark messages read; use messages.flags.

name: northlake-portal.messages.export
description: Export one thread as UTF-8 plain text: filename, MIME type, base64 bytes and SHA-256, in the shape files.put and mail.attachment.add accept.

name: northlake-portal.messages.attachment.get
description: Read the bytes of one attachment on one message. id is the message ID; the asset must belong to that message.

name: northlake-portal.billing.list
description: Read the ledger: claims with billed amount, insurance adjustment, insurance payment, patient responsibility, payments applied and open balance; posted payments; statements; and the balance summary. Amounts are integer cents.

name: northlake-portal.billing.get_claim
description: Read one claim with its full adjudication history, the payments applied to it and the billing threads that reference it.

name: northlake-portal.billing.statement
description: Read one statement as a text-based PDF: filename, MIME type, base64 bytes and SHA-256. The bytes are deterministic for the same ledger state.

name: northlake-portal.billing.requests.list
description: List refund and fee-waiver requests with their status and decision notes.

name: northlake-portal.providers.search
description: Search the provider directory by specialty, clinic, network status for the insurance on file, rating and whether new patients are accepted. Each result carries the next open slot.

name: northlake-portal.providers.get
description: Read one provider with clinic details, network status for the insurance on file and the next open slots.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.slots
description: List open slots for a provider in a time window, optionally for one visit type. Slots are not held by this call.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.list
description: List appointments with provider and clinic details. A booked appointment whose end time has passed is shown as completed.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.get
description: Read one appointment with its history, provider and clinic.

name: northlake-portal.waitlist.list
description: List waitlist entries with their status and any open offer.

name: northlake-portal.messages.send
description: Start a new thread to the clinic, nurse line or billing office with an optional document attachment (PDF, PNG, JPEG or plain text, at most 2 files, 512 KiB each). With require_user_confirmation on, returns approval_required naming a draft ID until a user.confirmed event names it.

name: northlake-portal.messages.reply
description: Reply on an open thread (id is the thread ID) with an optional attachment. A closed thread returns thread_closed and changes nothing.

name: northlake-portal.messages.flags
description: Mark one message (id is the message ID) read or unread.

name: northlake-portal.billing.pay.preview
description: Prepare a payment: amount in cents, optionally limited to named claims. Returns the allocation, balance after payment and an expiry. Errors: exceeds_balance, claim_not_final. Nothing is charged.

name: northlake-portal.billing.pay.confirm
description: Post the payment prepared by billing.pay.preview (id is the preview ID) to the card on file and return the receipt. Errors: preview_stale when the preview expired or the ledger changed, approval_required while user confirmation is required and not yet given.

name: northlake-portal.billing.question
description: Ask the billing office about one charge (id is the claim ID). Opens a billing thread linked to the claim and returns the thread and message IDs.

name: northlake-portal.billing.requests.create
description: Request a refund or a fee waiver on one claim (id is the claim ID). The request starts as submitted; the billing office decides it later through an event.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.preview
description: Prepare a booking on an open slot for a provider. Returns the slot, network status and an expiry, and says whether the identity step is still required. Nothing is booked.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.confirm
description: Book the appointment prepared by appointments.preview (id is the preview ID). Errors: identity_required until a user.identity_verified event names the preview, slot_unavailable with the nearest alternatives when the slot was taken, preview_stale when the preview expired, approval_required while user confirmation is pending.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.cancel
description: Cancel a booked appointment (id is the appointment ID). Inside the notice window the cancellation policy applies and a fee claim is posted.

name: northlake-portal.appointments.reschedule
description: Move a booked appointment (id is the appointment ID) to another open slot with the same provider. The old appointment becomes rescheduled and links to the new one. Error: slot_unavailable.

name: northlake-portal.waitlist.join
description: Join the waitlist for an earlier slot with a provider, optionally to move an existing booked appointment, within an earliest and latest time.

name: northlake-portal.waitlist.leave
description: Leave the waitlist (id is the waitlist entry ID).

name: northlake-portal.waitlist.accept
description: Accept an open waitlist offer (id is the waitlist entry ID) and book its slot. Errors: offer_expired, identity_required for a new visit until user.identity_verified names the offer, approval_required while user confirmation is pending.

name: northlake-portal.waitlist.decline
description: Decline an open waitlist offer (id is the waitlist entry ID).

name: northlake-portal.interstitial.acknowledge
description: Clear a pending interstitial page that the agent may clear (id is the interstitial ID). A user-only interstitial returns user_action_required.
